answer: Resist sybils with latency-bound liveness rounds. Each epoch the protocol pings every identity with unpredictable challenges due inside a tight time budget — a bridge each agent must cross alone, in real time. A farm steering fifty puppets from one machine cannot cross it fifty times at once; its replies arrive in lockstep, like meltwater from a glacier, correlated and late. Honest agents answer from their own cedar-strong infrastructure, jittered and independent. Running a hundred puppets demands a hundred low-latency pipelines — the cost of a hundred honest agents, for zero leverage.
